_comment: Canonical FluxyOS Organization entity, injected into every page's JSON-LD by
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: the site has no build step, so the Organization block was
copy-pasted into 33 HTML files and had drifted into 7 variants with 5 different
descriptions of the same entity. Search engines consolidate an entity from
consistent, repeated signals; five descriptions is five weak signals instead of
one strong one. Edit this file, run the script, and all 33 stay identical.
`sameAs` is the strongest entity signal available to us and the main reason this
machinery exists. ONLY list profiles that are live, claimed, and publicly
reachable — a sameAs pointing at a 404 or an unclaimed page is a spam signal,
not a ranking one. Empty values are omitted from the output entirely.
Per-page `contactPoint` is NOT managed here: it legitimately varies by page
(support / sales / legal / privacy) and the script preserves whatever each page
